title: Spotting fake news
instructions: Wybierz słowo (A, B, C lub D), które najlepiej pasuje do luki. Każda luka to 1 punkt.
text: In an age when anyone can publish anything online, it has never been more important to {{1}} a critical eye over what we read. False stories often {{2}} viral because they are shocking. Before sharing an article, check whether the source has a proven {{3}} record of accuracy. Many people share articles on the {{4}} of the moment, without reading beyond the headline. Be particularly {{5}} of headlines that seem designed to provoke anger. Research shows that people who are {{6}} to a wide range of viewpoints are better at recognising misinformation. Ultimately, the {{7}} for stopping fake news lies with all of us, not just with technology companies. As one journalist put it, 'If in {{8}}, don't share.'

gaps.explanation: Cast a critical eye over = przyjrzeć się krytycznie.
Go viral = rozprzestrzenić się błyskawicznie w sieci.
A proven track record = udokumentowane osiągnięcia.
On the spur of the moment = pod wpływem chwili (in the heat of the moment wymaga in).
Be wary of = uważać na; alert i attentive łączą się z to.
Be exposed to = mieć styczność z.
The responsibility for… lies with… = odpowiedzialność spoczywa na…
If in doubt = w razie wątpliwości.
